//: Auto-loaded by Claude Code. Registers the memini MCP server (memory_remember/recall/get/forget). Works local AND remote: set MEMINI_BASE_URL to your memini host (the /mcp suffix is appended here) and MEMINI_API_KEY to its token (MEMINI_TOKEN is an accepted alias for back-compat). NOTE: Claude Code expands ${VAR:-default} in this file FLAT — it does NOT support nested ${a:-${b:-c}} defaults (the inner braces leak into the value, e.g. https://host/mcp}/mcp}). So the URL keeps the variable in a single ${MEMINI_BASE_URL:-...} and appends the literal /mcp OUTSIDE the braces; don't add a trailing slash to MEMINI_BASE_URL. headersHelper resolves the per-project namespace + bearer via mcp-headers.mjs. LOCATING THAT SCRIPT: the helper DOES receive $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (measured against a live session; the shell expands it at run time, which is why it is escaped from Claude Code's own ${...} expansion below), so we use it first. The $XDG_CACHE_HOME/memini/plugin-root file the SessionStart hook writes stays as a fallback for older Claude Code versions that did not set the variable. If neither resolves, we emit just the bearer token so auth still succeeds and Claude Code doesn't drop into OAuth discovery. NOTE (Claude Code >= 2.1.238): plugin headersHelpers run WITHOUT inherited credential env vars, so the final printf fallback below (which reads $MEMINI_API_KEY from env) only helps on older versions; on 2.1.238+ the scripts path handles auth via the 0600 credentials file the SessionStart hook writes (see packages/memini-client/src/credential.ts). The printf last resort is kept because it only fires when neither CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT nor the breadcrumb resolves - i.e. before any hook ever ran, when the credentials file cannot exist yet either.

memini.headersHelper: R="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; if [ -z "$R" ] || [ ! -f "$R/scripts/mcp-headers.mjs" ]; then R=$(cat "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/memini/plugin-root" 2>/dev/null); fi; if [ -n "$R" ] && [ -f "$R/scripts/mcp-headers.mjs" ]; then exec "$R/scripts/run.sh" "$R/scripts/mcp-headers.mjs"; fi; t="${MEMINI_API_KEY:-$MEMINI_TOKEN}"; if [ -n "$t" ]; then printf '{"Authorization":"Bearer %s"}' "$t"; else printf '{}'; fi
